svg.title: 802.3br: an express mPacket
svg.desc: A synthetic express mPacket from the crate's tests, since the corpus has no IEEE 802.3br capture: seven preamble bytes 55, the SMD-E byte d5 that marks a complete express frame, then an ordinary Ethernet frame (destination 00:01:02:03:04:05, source 06:07:08:09:0a:0b, EtherType 0x0800, a 4-byte IPv4 stub) and the trailing 4-byte mCRC; the decoder strips the wrapper and delegates to the Ethernet decoder, so the link layer is an Ethernet DataLink carrying LinkType::IEEE802_3BR.
